# IWS (International Warehouse & Shipping)

> IWS is a full-service warehousing and Foreign Trade Zone (FTZ) provider for large industrial and manufacturing clients, with six facilities across Mobile, AL, Pensacola, FL, and Houston, TX.

IWS stores, manages, and moves raw materials, components, and finished goods for industrial and manufacturing clients. IWS works directly with Gulf Coast ports to receive raw materials, stores them securely across its warehouse network, and delivers them into production using its sister trucking company, Rolling Green Transportation, along with a trusted network of third-party carriers. IWS also stores and distributes finished goods once production is complete, and can integrate into a manufacturer's storage or component supply process.

## Services

- Warehousing & Distribution: public and contract warehousing across three states for raw materials, components, and finished goods.
- Foreign Trade Zone (FTZ) Services: FTZ-designated space that can defer, reduce, or eliminate customs duties on imported materials and goods.
- Port & Raw Material Logistics: receiving and staging raw materials and bulk shipments from Gulf Coast ports.
- Transportation & Drayage: in-house trucking via sister company Rolling Green Transportation (https://rollinggreentransportation.com), supplemented by vetted third-party carriers.
- Manufacturing & Component Supply Integration: sequencing deliveries and staging materials so production lines stay supplied.
- Finished Goods Storage & Distribution: warehousing and outbound distribution of completed products.
